accepted_one_level_reference: G02.var03 quantity/environment seed panel v1.0.1; used for scope context, not pooled into the nested-panel hypothesis test
common_model: One aircraft and the published three two-hour missions over 36 hours. From G02.var01 set both failure mode FRQ values to 50000 per million OPHOURS, NREPS to 256, and RSEED to the panel seed. Split POS-B's direct TEACH-LRU-01 child into POS-B -> POS-B-CH -> TEACH-LRU-01, and bind FM-POS-B to POS-B-CH while retaining its direct system CM location. POS-A remains unchanged apart from the common FRQ adjustment.

single_factor_variants.nested-baseline: POS-B ancestor QTYPM=1, ENVF=1.0; child POS-B-CH QTYPM=1, ENVF=1.0
single_factor_variants.nested-qty-two: Only POS-B ancestor QTYPM 1->2 relative to nested-baseline
single_factor_variants.nested-env-two: Only POS-B ancestor ENVF 1.0->2.0 relative to nested-baseline

pre_run_hypothesis: The nested branch imports, roundtrips and calculates. The native first-replication log identifies FM-POS-B on POS-B-CH with the POS-B ancestor in its connection path. If quantity and environment factors propagate down the MaterielStructure chain, each ancestor intervention increases aggregate SystemResults NFAIL and NREPT relative to the same-seed nested baseline.

pre_run_analysis.primary_outcome: Sum SystemResults NFAIL over the 72 nonoverlapping half-hour total unit/system bins, expressed as failures per 256 replications for each seed and arm.
pre_run_analysis.uncertainty: Across twelve predeclared matched seeds, report each paired difference, mean, sample standard deviation and nominal Student t 95% interval. For direction use an exact one-sided sign test for positive differences with Bonferroni threshold 0.025 per contrast; zero differences are nonpositive.
pre_run_analysis.acceptance_direction: Each contrast requires positive mean difference and exact sign p<0.025. At least one first-replication event must show FM-POS-B on POS-B-CH under POS-B. No exact doubling or one-level/multilevel equivalence claim.

acceptance_requires: All 36 runs pass guarded session-0 SSH and the host-wide Issue #18 mutex with GUI PID 13340 continuity.
Four native steps, exact populated-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors, nonempty valid report/log, and 72 aligned System/Stock bins per run.
Source and twelve raw files per run sealed with invocation and closure SHA-256 values.
Independent read-only replay of all source, raw, paired outcomes and stated limitations.
limitations: The first-only event log does not attribute 256-replication aggregate counts by position.
This panel does not establish exact rate multipliers, equivalence of one-level and two-level structure, physical replacement multiplicity, or general population laws.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
